svg.title: REAPER MCP system architecture overview
svg.desc: A complete high-level view of the clients, Python control plane, filesystem bridge, REAPER execution plane, rendering path, safety controls, and numbered request flow.

g.text: System architecture overview - local AI-to-DAW control plane
One shared behavior path for every interface
Runs inside the interactive DAW process
Five profiles | 18 capability groups | discovery and call gate
Hidden tools remain uncallable through stale discovery.
Mutation class, dry-run and undo contract
Stable GUID identity and result invariants
Polls requests, validates envelopes and dispatches commands
Serialized execution on REAPER's deferred loop
Optional path for long-running render jobs; normal DAW commands stay on the primary flow above
Render settings applied without mutating the live project
Short-lived renderer outside the interactive DAW
Primary source: implemented modules and live acceptance evidence
